documents.title: Shipping Policy
documents.text: Standard orders are prepared within one business day. Express delivery is available in selected cities. Customers receive a tracking code after shipment. Delivery delays may occur during public holidays.

documents.title: Returns Policy
documents.text: Unused products may be returned within fourteen days of delivery. The item must remain in its original condition. Refund processing begins after the returned package is inspected.

documents.title: Inventory Guide
documents.text: Inventory availability is updated after confirmed purchases. Products with zero available stock are not offered for new orders. Stock reservations can temporarily reduce available quantity.

documents.title: Payment Guide
documents.text: A successful payment receives a unique transaction reference. Failed payments do not complete the order. Payment status should be verified before fulfillment begins.
